name: ICAN / ICANIAN SN04 full-suspension fat-bike frameset
why_interesting: Official ICAN evidence identifies a 120 mm full-suspension fat-bike frame, contradicting the imported 100 mm soft-tail classification; the repository's fixed road/gravel allowance cannot represent an honest complete build.
missing: Resolve manufacturer conflicts in frame weight and carbon lay-up
Exact category and frameset package; official evidence excludes fork and shock
MTB-appropriate flat-bar complete-build specification and cost
Exact current mainland SKU, purchase route, warranty and return terms
source_note: Current exact product and collection pages support the listed size-specific tire options. The comparison value 122 mm is the rounded nominal-width equivalent of the 26×4.8 option listed for sizes 18/20; it is not a measured casing dimension and does not apply to size 16, which is limited to 26×4.0. Other wheel/tire pairings remain separate. Current manufacturer pages still conflict on frame weight (2,560 g storefront versus 2,507 g introduction and 2,057 ± 40 g corporate table) and carbon lay-up (T700 versus T700/T800). No weight or lay-up is selected.

facts.tire_clearance: 26×4.8 maximum for sizes 18/20 (≈122 mm nominal); 26×4.0 maximum for size 16 (≈102 mm nominal); exact product also lists 29×2.25-3.0 and 27.5×3.0-3.25 options
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Largest manufacturer-listed nominal width is 26×4.8 for sizes 18/20, converted from 4.8 in to 121.92 mm and rounded to 122; size 16 is limited to 26×4.0 (101.6 mm nominal), with separate 29×2.25–3.0 and 27.5×3.0–3.25 options. Actual tire casing width varies with tire and rim; this is a nominal size comparison, not a measured frame gap or a universal fit for every size.
facts.frame_weight_status: Manufacturer conflict: storefront 2,560 g; corporate-page introduction 2,507 g; same corporate page table 2,057 ± 40 g
facts.frame_material_status: Manufacturer conflict: Toray T700 versus T700/T800 across the current storefront and corporate product page
facts.stiffness_evidence: Exact-model manufacturer pages claim high-modulus construction and improved tapered-head/front-end stiffness, but publish no numeric value or reproducible protocol.
